# FDG4033

> DO NOT explicitly extend `System.ValueType`. In fact, most languages prevent this.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.7 Struct Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

The C# compiler rejects types that derive from System.ValueType (CS0644), as the text says; no analyzer is needed.

## From the book

In general, structs can be very useful, but they should be used only for small, single, immutable values that will not be boxed frequently.
